phases.objective: Expose one descriptor per visible public tool name and dispatch only the endpoint binding selected by endpoint_key without weakening Catalog V2 collision protection.

e2e_journeys.actor: authenticated platform admin or authenticated tenant member
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The caller receives one descriptor for the public name and the existing dispatcher receives only the explicitly selected visible endpoint binding.
steps: Resolve principal scope classes and tenant ownership restrictions.
Filter tenant-blocked tools before descriptor projection.
Group visible active rows by tool_name and expose a stable endpoint_key enum.
Require endpoint_key only when more than one visible binding exists.
Select the exact endpoint row before normalizing and dispatching call arguments.
assertions: github_rest_endpoint_dispatch appears exactly once in the catalog.
Tenant projection excludes admin-only endpoint keys.
Admin projection may include shared and admin-only endpoint keys.
Single-binding tools remain callable without endpoint_key.
SYSTEM_TOOL_DESCRIPTOR_NAME_COLLISION remains fail-closed for genuinely conflicting descriptors.

phases.objective: Preserve bounded deterministic lookup, structured non-secret errors, current generated evidence, and explicit Admin and Tenant guards.

e2e_journeys.actor: platform operator validating Admin and Tenant system-tool surfaces
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Operational checks prove ordered bounded candidate lookup, exact binding selection, principal-scoped visibility, and structured errors.
steps: Load a bounded candidate set ordered by endpoint_key and parent_action_key.
Prove candidates resolve to one public tool name.
Return visible allowed_endpoint_keys for missing or unknown selection.
Retain the explicit admin-required check after selection.
Expose error details through the shared system-layer envelope.
Regenerate frontend governance evidence from the exact candidate head.
assertions: Runtime does not use LIMIT 2 as a proxy for public-name uniqueness.
Runtime does not use rows[0] without cardinality proof.

phases.objective: Fail closed on missing, unknown, cross-name, or duplicate selected bindings while preserving tenant isolation and the catalog collision invariant.

e2e_journeys.actor: tenant or admin caller submitting incomplete or conflicting endpoint selection
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Invalid selection is rejected with a typed non-secret response before provider or endpoint dispatch.
steps: Call a multi-binding tool without endpoint_key.
Call with an endpoint_key outside the principal-visible set.
Evaluate candidates spanning more than one public tool name.
Evaluate a selected endpoint_key resolving to duplicate active rows.
Verify tenant projection excludes admin-only bindings.
assertions: Missing and unknown selection return status 400 typed errors.
Duplicate selected bindings return platform_endpoint_tool_binding_ambiguous with status 409.
No row deletion, tool-name rewrite, provider call, migration apply, or durability fallback occurs.

phases.objective: Verify principal-scoped descriptor projection and endpoint-key-selected dispatch against a non-production registry snapshot.
After governed promotion, verify live Admin and Tenant system-tool acceptance criteria against the exact deployed Production SHA.
